items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 6:1
items.html: The light of Beriah is the discernment of Hassadim separated from Hochma, and therefore they are called a new creation, and a light that is not the light of the essence but a light of offshoot. (ibid.) See answer 5.
